faults.quote: Having physical beauty; pleasant to look at.
faults.why: Ancient Greek sense; in Modern Greek καλός does not mean 'physically beautiful' (όμορφος/ωραίος).

faults.quote: It covers both moral goodness and aesthetic beauty.
faults.why: False for Modern Greek; καλός does not mean aesthetically beautiful.

faults.quote: The sea is very beautiful today.
faults.why: Η θάλασσα είναι καλή means the sea is calm/good for swimming, not 'beautiful'.
Illustrates moral kindness ('good/kind person'), not general 'high quality'.
